title: Reverse comparison composed with the right-derived unit
statement: For A,B,φ,i as in [def-pc-affine-derived-pushforward-sheaf-edge-canonical], let D be any cochain complex of module sheaves on Spec A such that Q(D) has quasi-coherent cohomology. Homology of the actual right-derived unit on D, followed by the canonical reverse comparison at Q(D), equals the localization/homology factor for termwise f_*D, followed by leftExactHomologyComparison(D.sc i,f_*) [def-pc-left-exact-homology-comparison], followed by f_* of the inverse localization/homology factor for D. No exact module-valued functor is assumed.

source.place: 0AVW, proof, affine cohomology display; 08D4, bound-one truncation comparison on inverse images of affine opens.

proof.text: Choose a quasi-isomorphism q:D→I with I K-injective. The kernel lift is natural in q; precompose with the homology projection to prove naturality of the reverse homology comparison. Transport the square through the localization factors.

At I use the defining characterization of the unique descended reverse comparison. Naturality of the right-derived unit and of the reverse comparison with Q(q) gives the formula at D after cancelling homology of Q(q). No invertibility of termwise pushforward of q is needed.
